summary: Records the owner decision that Nex Core is only the host image, booting under UEFI and BIOS, and the removal of the previous apt-managed install path from code and documentation. API impact: changed contract (removed Controller update and system-disk routes).

guide.reason: The install guide no longer says the image is permanently UEFI-only; it says BIOS boot is decided but not built, so current behaviour stays accurate.

api.reason: Contract decision: changed contract. Removed /api/v1/updates, /api/v1/updates/apply, /api/v1/hosts/{id}/system-disk and the host-system-disk-replace command; local update routes are image-only. Both sides changed together.

roadmap.reason: Records an owner decision in the existing immutable plan (D2, open questions, Phase 4); no new milestone or acceptance gate is promoted.

verification.method: go build ./... clean; go vet and focused go test for hostimage, nexupdate, protocol, vmhost, agent; installer/check.sh and test_api_contract passed on LF copies in WSL; check_docs passed. Not run: any ISO or image build, a real or QEMU BIOS boot, controller/localcore tests (no cgo in WSL), image/packages.lock regeneration.
